description: This Java class defines a TileService for Android's quick settings, providing a tile to quickly create a new note by launching the EditNoteActivity.

classes.name: NewNoteTileService
classes.description: A TileService that adds a quick setting tile for creating new notes. It updates the tile state to active when listening and launches the note editing activity when clicked.

methods.name: onStartListening
methods.description: Sets the quick setting tile state to active and updates the tile when it starts listening.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles the tile click event by creating an intent to launch the EditNoteActivity, configuring flags to prevent multiple instances, and then unlocking the device to start the activity.
